description: Keep Phase 10A results as-is; do nothing further. Use as-is for documentation/learning only. Block Phase 11 for these signals until a different signal generation approach is tried.
Replace mean spread with median spread as primary evaluation metric. Median is positive for 11/12 combos. Reframes signal as works for median cross-section but not for mean.

Remove bucket 0 (lowest-signal decile) from the short leg. Bucket 0 has structurally higher returns. Shorting bucket 0 is the primary source of negative mean spread. Guard: do not short bottom decile.
Combine: (1) do not short bucket 0; (2) use median/winsorized spread; (3) add tail guard capping bucket 0 exposure to 0 if short-leg bucket 0 count > threshold. Most comprehensive tail-aware policy.
For 24h/72h: consider inverting signal direction. For 1h/4h: keep original direction. Evaluate each horizon separately with its own direction. Most nuanced policy.

Combine POLICY_C (bucket 0 guard) with POLICY_E (horizon-specific direction): (1) do not short bucket 0; (2) for 24h/72h evaluate inverted; (3) for 1h/4h evaluate original with guard. Most complete. Recommended as Phase 10D target.
